summary: DevicesMFE is a UI page class that inherits from HPXFlow and provides comprehensive automation methods for the Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) interface. It contains verification methods to check the visibility and state of various UI elements like device cards, printer information, navigation icons, and user authentication status. The class also includes action methods for interacting with the interface such as clicking buttons, scrolling, refreshing, and managing window states. It handles Windows-specific dummy printer interactions, device card operations, profile management, and various navigation flows. The class is designed for automated testing of the HP device management interface with support for login/logout verification, device discovery, and UI element interactions.
